name: zsazsa-report-story
description: One story of a long CTI report imported into the zsazsa CTI program, with its context for a threat landscape

report-uuid.description: UUID of the imported report the story was taken from

story-id.description: The story's id in the report's manifest

kind.description: assessment, incident, finding, outlook or context

period.description: The period the story's facts cover, as the report says it

section.description: The sections of the report the story is under

pages.description: Pages of the report the story is on

blocks.description: First and last block of the report's text the story is made of

threat-type.description: Threat type, one of the prime threats a threat landscape entry is classified by

affected-assets.description: What the story says was affected

impact.description: What the story says the impact was

motivation.description: What the story says drove the actor

mitigation.description: What the story says mitigates it

evidence.description: JSON: each value of the story's context with the block of the report that states it
